summary: Central Elections Committee chairman Justice Noam Sohlberg issued a temporary injunction ordering Netanyahu to remove a campaign video showing him interacting and taking selfies with children at Jerusalem's Malha Mall.
notes: Primary petition/order bundle recovered. It identifies case TBC 114/26, orders immediate removal from all social-media accounts, permits reposting after cutting segments with children in personal contact, and requires respondents' answer by Aug. 17. The bundle also recovers the exact original Aug. 11 verified Facebook video URL: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1bt5Hug87o/ . Times of Israel independently describes the order as temporary and says deliberations would continue until a final ruling. Searches through Sept. 2 still did not surface a final ruling, so preserve Pending and do not convert the interim order into a final adjudication. A later Haaretz headline reported the video remained available a week after the order, but that follow-up is not yet supported by a sufficiently complete primary record for a separate accepted noncompliance event.
